cs.t: I recommend a TKL from Aliexpress. Gateron Yellows are fine switches. (For example - recently I tested a Keydous NJ80 - didn't get used to the layout - but loved the quality. Most mech keyboards are great unless you try the really high end stuff first... I'd say you get what you pay for and around 80-100 USD you can get a good enough keyboard)
